review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer .NET (Quality Engineering)
review_candidates.description: Good to know: you can easily save this vacancy using the print button at the top of the page. After the closing date, this vacancy will be removed from our website. You build .NET/C# services that connect large batteries, rooftop solar and other customer-side assets to our Virtual Power Plant. You make quality part of how features get built: automated integration and E2E tests, plus load and performance testing for a system that runs 24/7 in live energy markets. You help the team work smarter with AI-assisted development, from test generation to debugging. Why choose Eneco? At Eneco we work towards one clear goal: being climate-neutral by 2035. A big part of that is flexibility, using renewable energy at the right moment. Our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) links many energy sources and steers them centrally as one portfolio. More and more of that flexibility sits "behind the meter", at our customers' sites: large batteries, solar panels and other installations. Your services make it possible for these smaller assets to join the market together. That means more green energy used well, and less need for fossil backup. You do this in a team that takes engineering seriously, shares what it learns, and gives you room to grow as a technical leader. What You’ll Do You build and maintain backend services and integrations in .NET/C#. You develop solutions that optimise behind-the-meter assets and connect data flows so smaller assets can trade as part of Eneco's pool. You design and maintain automated integration and end-to-end tests, so the team can trust every release of our services and integrations. You run load and performance tests to find bottlenecks, scalability risks and reliability issues before they reach production. You keep improving test automation, test coverage and feedback cycles, so developers know quickly when something breaks. You build quality into features from the start, instead of testing them afterwards. You use AI tools across your work, including test generation, refactoring and debugging, and review the output critically. You drive Proofs of Concept and work with architects on system design. You mentor medior and junior engineers through code reviews and technical guidance. You share on-call duty for a system that runs 24/7. Is this about you? You have around 7 years of backend experience in .NET/C# and have built complex, high-availability distributed systems. You know event-driven architecture and async messaging, for example Kafka, Azure Event Hubs or RabbitMQ. You're comfortable with Azure, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, microservices, and both relational and non-relational data. You have a strong Quality Engineering mindset: to you, quality, testability and automation are part of building software. You have practical experience with automated integration and E2E testing. You've done load and performance testing and know how to investigate performance and scalability risks. You're a software engineer first. You enjoy building features and the tests that prove they work, rather than focusing on test automation alone. You use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work, check their output critically, and like sharing what works with your team. You're happy to take on-call responsibility, live in the Netherlands and speak English fluently. Knowledge of energy markets, optimisation or aggregation platforms is a plus. Don't have it yet? You'll learn the domain here. Recognise yourself in most of this, but not every requirement? We'd still love to hear from you. You’ll be responsible for Reliable, scalable services that connect distributed assets to our VPP and keep running 24/7. Quality built into the development lifecycle through automated testing. New features and services that ship with the right integration and E2E test coverage. Performance and scalability, backed by load and performance testing. Faster, more reliable feedback for the team through more automation. Technical ownership of your components, including tackling technical debt and reliability risks early. AI-assisted work that meets the same bar for security, quality and maintainability as anything else. A stronger team through reviews, mentoring and shared standards. This is where you’ll work You join an engineering team working on the platforms behind our Virtual Power Plant. You work closely with fellow engineers, architects and colleagues from other disciplines. We review each other's code, share what we learn, and explore AI and automation together, so you get plenty of room to bring in your own ideas. What We Have To Offer Gross annual salary between €80,000 and €120,000 Including FlexBudget, 8% holiday allowance, and depending on your role a bonus or collective profit sharing. FlexBudget Have it paid out, use it to buy extra holiday days or save it up for something nice, it's up to you. Personal and professional growth Eneco is fully committed to help you in your personal and professional development. Hybrid working: home, office or abroad Work 40% at the office, 40% from home, and 20% flexibly. With manager approval, you may work abroad (within approved countries) up to 3 weeks/year, max 2 consecutively. Want more information about our terms of employment? Here's what you get from us Work Where Everyone Matters When you choose a career at Eneco, you choose ambition, growth, and opportunity in an environment where everyone matters. You’re given the space to develop yourself and to do your work in a way that suits you. We believe that different perspectives, nationalities, and backgrounds make us stronger, which is why we foster an open, safe and inclusive culture. Naturally, we also prioritize a healthy work-life balance, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when your role allows it. If you have a physical or sensory disability, we will work with you to find the right adjustments so you can perform your job well. This is how you build your own future and a sustainable future at the same time. Together with 4,000 colleagues, each with their own talents and ideas, you work on our shared mission: speeding up the energy transition. We help customers become more sustainable faster, create innovative solutions, and seize new opportunities. Will you join us? The phases of our application procedure Want to know more about this job function? With this job vacancy, we aim to recruit a new colleague for Eneco. Therefore, this is not a solicitation for acquisition.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (forward development)
review_candidates.description: Company Description QGI builds systems where outcomes are visible, explainable, and accountable by design, focusing on intelligence that can be observed, examined, and defended. Rather than chasing faster answers or louder predictions, QGI develops technologies that resolve uncertainty into clarity before actions are taken. The company rejects opaque “black box” approaches, ensuring that decisions are never both unclear and final. At QGI, intelligence is defined as the decision, the explanation, and the evidence presented together, so users rely on what can be clearly seen and understood, not guesswork or blind trust. Role Description The Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain backend services and systems that support QGI’s explainable and accountable intelligence platforms. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing scalable software solutions, writing clean and well-tested code, participating in code reviews, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate research concepts into production-ready features. The engineer will also troubleshoot and optimize existing systems, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve development processes and tooling. This is a full-time remote role, requiring effective communication, self-management, and the ability to work productively in a distributed team environment. Qualifications Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. Hands-on experience in Software Development and Programming, with proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, Go). Practical skills in Back-End Web Development, including RESTful APIs, microservices, and integration with data storage systems. Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their application in building maintainable, modular codebases. Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows. Experience with AI coding systems (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and Agentic coding. Familiarity with cloud platforms or containerization (e.g., AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes) is beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, communicate clearly, and collaborate with research and product teams.

review_candidates.title: Développeur Senior JavaScript / Backend H/F
review_candidates.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale. Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Description du poste NEXTON recrute un Développeur Senior JavaScript / Backend H/F en CDI, à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Tu intègres l'équipe pour l'un de nos grands comptes afin de participer à la conception, au développement et à l'optimisation d'applications web backend à forte audience. Tes missions : Conception et Développement : Analyser les besoins métier, concevoir et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités robustes en Node.js, NestJS et Express. Qualité et Refactoring : Améliorer en continu la qualité, la lisibilité et les performances du code existant, et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement. Architecture et Performance : Mettre en œuvre des architectures applicatives (SOLID, Clean/Hexagonale, microservices), gérer le traitement asynchrone (RabbitMQ) et optimiser la gestion du cache (Varnish, Redis, Memcached). Tests et Qualité logicielle : Rédiger et exécuter les tests unitaires et d'intégration (Jest, Vitest) dans une démarche TDD et un contexte CI/CD. Collaboration et Agilité : Participer aux revues de code, rédiger la documentation technique, partager tes connaissances et être un acteur clé des cérémonies Agile. Qualifications Qualifications : De formation supérieure, tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience significative en développement backend JavaScript / Node.js. Tu maîtrises parfaitement NodeJS (24), NestJS, Express , ainsi que les systèmes de messagerie ( RabbitMQ ) et les stratégies de cache applicatif et reverse proxy ( Varnish, Redis ). Tu as une solide connaissance des principes d'architecture logicielle (SOLID, Clean Architecture, microservices, design patterns). Tu pratiques couramment les tests automatisés (TDD, Jest/Vitest) et tu maîtrises les environnements conteneurisés ( Docker ) ainsi que Git . Des compétences sur Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, CDN (Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront) ou une expérience dans le secteur des médias/éditorial sont un vrai plus. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ? Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année : ▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours. ▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences. ▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser. ▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir. ▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce. ▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous ! NEXTON
